props.name: compareAt
props.description: Formatted price before the sale, struck through on sale.

props.name: rating
props.description: Average rating out of 5: that many stars are filled (rounded).

props.name: hoverAdd
props.description: Reveal the add-to-cart button over the image on hover (always shown on touch screens).

props.name: image
props.description: Product image URL; a neutral tile when empty.

props.name: alt
props.description: Image alternative text; defaults to the title.

props.name: labels
props.description: UI copy; every key is optional and falls back to the English default.

props.name: animated
props.description: Play the entrance animation (default false). When false, render the final state.

props.name: fill
props.description:
Make the visual fill the box it is given instead of sitting in the gallery preview frame: drops the frame's side padding, stretches on the cross axis and removes the module's `max-w-*` cap. Off by default, so the preview rendering — and every golden — is unchanged.

Turn it on to use a visual as a panel in an app layout, where a centred, capped card gives mismatched widths and edges from one cell to the next.

props.name: rating
props.description: `{rating}` is replaced by the rating value.
